data.overview: After losing his wife, a father buys a country estate that comes with a struggling zoo. His daughter embraces the animals, his grieving son resists the upheaval, and the staff join him in a race to restore the grounds before the bills force the gates shut.
data.tagline: A family can find its way back together.
